title: Darkness Before Dawn
next_chapter_hook: A breath from beyond the Three Realms seeps through the dimensional rift; the First Observer's dying words begin to manifest, and fate's countdown nears zero.

text.content:
The thirty-day deadline, only three hours remain.

In the bronze water clock of the Tianji Hall, the final grains of sand drift slowly downward, each impact against the bottom striking Chen Ji's heart. Beyond the hall, the turmoil of the Three Realms has been suppressed into near silence by the new order—sects bow in submission on the surface, the remnants of the Demonic Path retreat into the Netherworld, and the age-old struggle between light and darkness, spanning millennia, is temporarily suspended due to the Observer's appearance.

But Chen Ji knows this is merely the dormancy before the storm.

He stands with hands clasped behind his back on the star map at the hall's center, the Tianji Record Fragment floating before him, emanating a faint yet eerie silver glow. Within that silver light, the outline of the dimensional rift is faintly visible—it has widened since three days ago, and from its edges continuously seep breaths beyond comprehension.

Mo Xiansheng's voice drifts from the fragment: "The final arrangement is complete, but the rift's growth rate exceeds expectations. Are you certain you want to personally inspect it before the countdown reaches zero?"

Chen Ji offers no answer, merely reaching out to brush across the Tianji Record's pages. A sharp sting travels through his fingertips—a warning of Heavenly Fate draining away.

dialogue.content:
Light footsteps echo outside the hall. Ye Qing's silhouette appears at the entrance. Her Demonic Path mist is suppressed to its extreme, nearly merging with the night itself, yet those blood-red pupils gleam starkly in the darkness.

"Chen Ji," her voice is low and urgent, "abnormal fluctuations have emerged on the east side of the rift. From the higher dimension... something is looking this way."

She pauses, adding: "Not surveillance. Gazing."

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze tightens imperceptibly. He understands what "gazing" signifies—this is not the instinctive curiosity of lower-dimensional beings regarding higher dimensions, but the active observation of higher-dimensional existences toward lower realms.

For thirty days, every piece he has positioned across the Three Realms was for this moment. The Observer's identity, the establishment of the new order, the temporary compromise among various powers... all of it served to maintain sufficient stability in the Three Realms during this final hour, enabling concentrated force to face the impending threat.

But now, that threat has manifested ahead of schedule.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji turns, his voice terrifyingly calm: "The east side... is Han Lie's monitoring zone."

Ye Qing nods: "He has already sent word, but the content contains only four characters—'It has come.'"

Chen Ji closes his eyes, thoughts racing. That reckless fool Han Lie, sending only four characters before losing contact—this means either he encountered a threat beyond description, or... he has already been affected by that "gaze."

"I understand," Chen Ji murmurs, "waiting for the moment."

choice.prompt: The dimensional rift's anomaly has arrived three hours ahead of schedule. Facing this variable, Chen Ji must decide—wait for the countdown to end as originally planned, or immediately head to the rift's core?

choices.description: All arrangements are complete; before the countdown ends, disturbing the situation must be avoided. Rash action may plunge the Three Realms into premature chaos.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the optimal intervention timing
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the complete layout; the Three Realms remain temporarily stable
choices.risk_hint: The rift anomaly may trigger disaster ahead of schedule

text.content:
Chen Ji draws a deep breath and makes his decision. "Ye Qing, notify all parties to enter first-level standby status, but do not alarm ordinary disciples. Within these final three hours, I will personally go to the rift."

Ye Qing frowns: "Alone?"

"No," Chen Ji shakes his head, "I am bringing someone."

choices.description: The early anomaly indicates higher-dimensional existences are more eager to descend than anticipated. Firsthand intelligence must be obtained immediately to make adjustments.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence ahead of schedule

text.content:
Before the words finish, Chen Ji has already stepped out of the Tianji Hall. Ye Qing tries to stop him, but is halted by his raised hand. "Tell Ling Yuan and the old sect master, the Observer has matters outside and will return soon. Tell them to keep their disciples in check."

His silhouette vanishes into the night, leaving only these words: "If I have not returned within two hours, initiate the backup plan."

At that moment, the sky outside the hall suddenly darkens.

Not the darkness of nightfall, but a oppressive sense as if something is covering the stars. Chen Ji looks up to see the previously bright star river blurring at a visible speed, its edges rippling with layers of waves.

The dimensional rift—it is expanding.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji."

A clear, cold voice arrives from behind. Chen Ji does not turn, yet his spine tightens slightly—he knows this voice too well.

Su Qingyao has somehow appeared at the hall entrance. Her moon-white robes flutter gently in the night breeze. Her gaze remains cold as ever, but Chen Ji notices her fingers tightly gripping the sword hilt at her waist.

"Thirty days," she says, "what exactly are you preparing for?"

text.content:
Ye Qing instinctively steps back, her Demonic Path mist churning around her, yet suppressed by some invisible pressure. She recognizes this woman—Su Qingyao, Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect.

But what alarms her more is something else: how did this woman pass through the new order's layers of defenses, arriving silently at the Tianji Hall?

Chen Ji turns, a hint of helpless resignation appearing on his face. "Senior Sister Su, visiting at such a late hour, what brings you here?"

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao offers no answer, instead walking slowly into the hall. Her gaze sweeps across the floating Tianji Record Fragment, sweeps past Ye Qing, finally fixing on Chen Ji's face.

"Three days ago, you used the Tianji Record at the rift's edge, consuming fifteen points of Heavenly Fate." Her voice is soft, yet precise as a blade, "Yesterday, you used it twice more. I checked the records—each use of the Tianji Record consumes five points of Heavenly Fate..."

She pauses, her gaze sharpening suddenly: "How much Heavenly Fate do you have remaining?"

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao has already uncovered Chen Ji's secret of Heavenly Fate consumption. As the only person who noticed the anomaly, her interrogation strikes at the core. Chen Ji must decide how to respond.

choices.text: Honestly reveal part of the truth
choices.description: Su Qingyao's intelligence and determination far exceed ordinary people. Continued concealment will only deepen her suspicion. Better to reveal part of the truth and earn her trust.
choices.risk_hint: The truth may exceed her capacity to bear

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then sighed softly. "Since you've discovered this much, you should also know what Heavenly Fate means to me." He raised his hand, and silver light flowed from the Tianji Record, condensing into a small orb of light in his palm. "Now there are only twenty-three points left."

Su Qingyao's eyes widened slightly. Twenty-three points—this meant Chen Ji only had four uses of the Tianji Record remaining.

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶开始深入了解陈机的秘密

choices.text: Continue concealing and change the subject
choices.description: Heavenly Fate is the final trump card, never to be easily exposed. Use other topics to redirect her attention and buy time.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's expression didn't change at all. "Su Senior Sister's information is truly well-informed." He smiled, his tone as relaxed as if discussing the weather. "However, regarding Heavenly Fate... when I'm ready, I'll naturally tell you. What's more important now—"

He raised his hand, pointing to the distorting starry sky. "Look outside."

text.content:
Su Qingyao didn't fall for it; her gaze remained fixed on Chen Ji's face. "You think changing the subject can fool me?"

Just then, a blinding white light burst from the crack in the sky. Everyone instinctively raised their hands to shield their eyes, but that radiance seemed to penetrate everything, branding itself directly onto their retinas.

Chen Ji's pupils constricted—in the Tianji Record's vision, he saw a silhouette.

It was an eye.

A colossal eye composed of infinite nebulae and chaotic energy, transcending all comprehension.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao.

This name rose from the depths of Chen Ji's heart, carrying an indescribable chill. He finally understood why the "fatal backlash" in the Tianji Record's prophecy would be so intense—because from the very beginning, he had been targeted by a higher-dimensional existence.

Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang in his mind, no longer the usual calm, but carrying a rare hint of anxiety: "Chen Ji, it's here. The First Observer's testament... is about to be fulfilled."

"What testament?" Chen Ji urgently asked in his heart.

But Mo Xiansheng gave no answer; the silver light on the Tianji Record began to tremble violently.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji!"

Su Qingyao's exclamation pulled Chen Ji back to reality. He looked down and realized he had somehow dropped to one knee, his forehead covered in cold sweat. The Tianji Record floated before him, the characters on its pages flashing madly, as if issuing some kind of warning.

"You..." Su Qingyao stepped forward quickly, reaching out to support his shoulder. It was the first time she had voluntarily touched Chen Ji, the warmth of her palm causing him to pause slightly.

"I'm fine," he took a deep breath,勉强站起身, "I just saw... something that shouldn't have been seen."

Ye Qing's voice came from beside, tinged with trembling: "That eye... I saw it too."

Su Qingyao turned to look at her, her expression complex. One was the Inner Sect Senior Fellow of the righteous path, the other the Holy Sect's Saint—yet now they stood together against the same threat.

"It's not just us," Ye Qing continued, "Han Lie, Ling Yuan... everyone connected to the rift should have seen it."

Chen Ji closed his eyes and said in a low voice: "This means the new order... may not hold much longer."

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heavenly Dao manifests, shaking the foundation of the new order. Facing this ultimate threat, Chen Ji must make a choice between two directions—protecting the peace built over these thirty days, or revealing the complete truth to everyone?

choices.text: Protect peace and conceal the truth
choices.description: Thirty days of planning came not easily; once the truth is exposed, the Three Realms will inevitably fall into chaos. First stabilize the situation, then find ways to eliminate threats one by one.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain stability in the Three Realms and buy time
choices.risk_hint: May miss the optimal response window

text.content:
Chen Ji opened his eyes and looked around at the three people. His gaze finally landed on Su Qingyao's face, the complex emotions in those eyes causing his heart to stir slightly.

"What I saw cannot be said for now." His voice returned to its usual calm. "But one thing is certain—the existence behind the dimensional rift is attempting to descend upon the Three Realms. We have less than three hours."

He looked at Ye Qing: "Notify Han Lie, have him contract the defensive line, and do not look directly at that eye."

choices.description: The Eye of Heavenly Dao is not something any single faction can handle. Only when all who know the truth unite can there be any chance of surviving this crisis.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger panic across the Three Realms
choices.risk_hint: The truth may shake the foundations of the new order

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, making a decision that even surprised himself. "Do you want to know what I saw?" His voice was soft, yet carried an unprecedented solemnity. "The Heavenly Divine Eye." Su Qingyao and Ye Qing both changed expression. The Heavenly Divine Eye—this name only appeared in the most ancient texts, legend had it that it was an existence beyond the immortal and demonic realms, the ultimate destination of all seers. "And the Tianji Record..." Chen Ji said bitterly, "is merely one of the pieces it has placed in this world."

text.content: After his words fell, silence descended upon the hall like death. Ye Qing's breathing quickened, demonic mist churning violently around her. Su Qingyao's fingers remained gripping her sword hilt, but this time not from vigilance—it was from shock. Chen Ji didn't give them much time to process this news. He turned and walked toward the platform outside the hall, gazing up at the giant eye slowly opening. Stars rotated around it, the Milky Way flowing through its pupils—grandeur and terror beyond any language could describe. "The First Observer left behind a final message before death," Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out hauntingly, "'When the Heavenly Divine Eye opens, the chessboard will be reshuffled.'"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao walked to Chen Ji's side, standing shoulder to shoulder with him. Her voice was no longer cold, but carried a rare warmth: "You knew from the very beginning, didn't you?" Chen Ji remained silent. "So that's why you walked the world playing the fool," she continued, "so that's why you established a new order, stabilized everyone... you were buying time." She turned to look at Chen Ji, and in the moonlight, her eyes held a light he had never seen before. "You were protecting us."

Ye Qing also walked over, standing on Chen Ji's other side. In her crimson eyes, there was no longer only the ruthlessness of the demonic path, but also a trace of sympathetic understanding. "During those years the Holy Sect used me," she said softly, "I thought I was the most pitiful piece. But compared to you..." She didn't finish. Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice calm yet firm: "A piece has its own way of surviving. If the Heavenly Divine Eye wants to use me as a tool, then I'll let it know—" He raised his head, staring directly at the giant eye watching him. "Some pieces devour the ones who move them."

text.content: At this very moment, the dimensional rift shuddered violently once more. That rift was no longer a mere black abyss, but from it emerged an aura surpassing the laws of the Three Realms. Spreading outward like ripples, where it passed, spiritual energy chaotic and laws twisted. Chen Ji's Tianji Record suddenly erupted with dazzling silver light, an influx of information forcibly entering his mind— The First Observer's dying words were completely fulfilled at this moment. "The countdown..." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried unprecedented urgency, "has ended prematurely."

Outside the Tianji Hall, simultaneous prodigies appeared across the Three Realms. The celestial cranes of Tianqing Sect shrieked and circled, the black fog of the Demonic Sacred Land suddenly boiled, the Xuanwu Sect's mountain-protecting formation activated automatically, and even from the long-silent Netherworld Land came the wails of departed souls. The superficial peace built over thirty days collapsed utterly the moment the Heavenly Divine Eye opened. And the end point of the countdown was no longer three hours away—it was now.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji felt the information flooding into his mind, the last fragment of complete foresight the Tianji Record possessed. The images were blurry and fragmented, but the core content was crystal clear— Three days. Only three days remaining. If they couldn't stop the Heavenly Divine Eye's complete descent after three days, the Three Realms would be utterly reshaped, all living beings reduced to puppets of heavenly will. He opened his eyes, looking at the two standing shoulder to shoulder beside him, a wry smile forming at the corner of his mouth. "It seems... there's no time for careful planning anymore."

text.content: From afar, a low rumble echoed from the dimensional rift. This was no ordinary sound, but something surpassing sound waves entirely, directly shaking the souls of the three present. Ye Qing groaned, dropping to one knee; Su Qingyao's sword energy automatically activated, forming a protective shield; even the Tianji Record fragment on Chen Ji's chest trembled violently. And in the heavens above, within the Heavenly Divine Eye's pupil, a massive rune slowly taking shape was faintly visible. That was... the countdown to apocalypse.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao abruptly drew her longsword, its blade reflecting the giant eye in the sky. "Three days is three days!" Her voice was cold yet resolute, "I, Su Qingyao, have never feared any enemy since I began cultivating. What is the Heavenly Divine Eye—" She turned to look at Chen Ji, her eyes burning with unprecedented light: "You've plotted for thirty years, I'll go mad with you this one time." Ye Qing also struggled to her feet, demonic mist reconverging: "The Holy Sect still owes me a debt I haven't collected. Before that, no one touches him."

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at the two women beside him, an unfamiliar warmth flooding his heart. For thirty days, he had grown accustomed to calculating alone, bearing alone. But now, facing the approaching apocalyptic crisis, two people were willing to stand at his side. He drew a deep breath, regaining his usual composure. "In that case—" He raised his hand, the silver light of the Tianji Record igniting once more, "Let the Three Realms witness what it truly means... to be the ultimate wolf in sheep's clothing." Outside the Tianji Hall, the Heavenly Divine Eye watched all this unfold, the rune in its pupil flickering with increasing intensity. The chess game of fate had finally entered its final phase.
